caption: The drawing depicts a single metal teapot with a rounded body, a domed lid, a sturdy handle arched over the top, and a pronounced, curved spout connected near its upper side. The teapot is rendered in shades of copper and brown, displaying a patina with greenish and darker spots indicating tarnish and age. Decorative ridges and ringed ornamentation are visible around the lid and on the fixtures attaching the handle and spout. The object is centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background, and there is no additional context or items in the composition. At the lower right of the teapot, the artist's name "WAYNE WHITE" is printed in small red-brown capital letters.
title: Copper Tea Kettle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
